title: A same-PR fix after a passed fix check can reuse the record when the new head's tree equals the record head's tree
why: Lane notes-fix-large-3 ([ended:lane:-notes-fix-large-3]): on #1706 two empty Drops-lines commits after a record with a Fix check line left a tree-identical head; merge --fix-check refuses a second fix check, so the PR needs a fresh three-round chain.
note: Filed 10:38 CST Nov 8 apart from replacement-pr-carries-review, whose lane declined it (a wider act). Fix: the refusal names the cost (a fresh chain), and a record is accepted when the new head's tree equals the newest record head's tree; it may reuse that lane's git diff --quiet proof in fix_base_problem. Owner item 426 a (2 fix checks per chain) may also cover the #1706 case. 10:42 CST Nov 8 (coordinator 10:40 CST): covered by #2326, which builds owner item 426 a (2 fix checks per chain), so #1706 takes a second fix check once #2326 lands, or a fresh chain if it cannot wait. Done when #2326 merges; reopen if a third same-tree push recurs. Dead wait re-pointed 13:18 CST Nov 10 (step dead-pr-waits): #1957 closed unmerged; #2326 replaced it. Lane cleared 08:59 CST Nov 12: its session (was "lane: notes-fix-large-3") is archived (coordinator ask 08:57 CST Nov 12, sweep of ended session ids). Lane field cleared 10:59 CST Nov 12: its session (lane notes-fix-large-3) is archived. Lane review-record-stack started 11:00 CST Nov 12 to finish #2326, which conflicts with main per runner 10 (coordinator 11:01 CST). Re-pointed 11:06 CST Nov 12 (coordinator 11:05 CST): lane review-record-stack drops #2326's chain of two fix checks (item 426 a), because restart-plan R1 (owner 14:07 CST Nov 10) folded fix-check-chain into decision pr-review-record, where main has one fix verifier per record. R1 settles the clean-merge case (pr-review-record line 75). The rest, a non-merge push whose tree equals the record head's tree, had one hit (#1706), and this step said to reopen on a third. Closed as a note (rule roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes); it becomes a debt on a real recurrence. Incident, coordinator 12:25 CST Nov 13: #3172 (counts-from-rest) moved head after a Fix check for a comments-only lint fix (7 lines, 1 file, b3c6e654e). `merge --review-record` refuses a second Fix check, so it owes three fresh rounds. Widen the step: a comments-only diff after a Fix check (tokenizer-proven) could reuse the record. Not lane-ready until it measures how often this happens. Second incident, 12:46 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 12:46 CST): #2715's revert made its tree equal the fully reviewed a846e976c, but the record chain was closed by an earlier Fix check line, so it needs a new PR and round 1. A tree-equal head cannot reuse the record once a Fix check line exists. Two incidents now (#3172, #2715).
